articles.summary: Modern Treasury partners with Sardine to enhance transaction monitoring, fraud prevention, and compliance for payments across stablecoins, wire, ACH, RTP, FedNow, and Push-to-Card. The integration helps businesses detect risk earlier and scale secure payment operations.
articles.title: Modern Treasury Partners With Sardine to Help Businesses Detect Fraud Earlier and Reduce Risk at Scale

articles.summary: Modern Treasury now supports USDC on Base, enabling businesses to send, receive, and reconcile stablecoin payments alongside ACH, wires, and RTP through a single API, with built-in conversion, compliance, and unified ledgering.
articles.title: Modern Treasury Adds USDC on Base, Expanding Stablecoin Support

articles.summary: Symphony chose Modern Treasury's payments infrastructure and stablecoin APIs to power its rewards savings platform, enabling automated deposits, seamless money movement, and a fixed 5% APY across traditional banking and blockchain networks.
articles.title: Symphony Selects Modern Treasury's Payments Infrastructure to Power Rewards Savings Platform
